summary: The fixed in-progress preview is a faithful, offline-safe view of its frozen source snapshot. The source SHA-256 matches the HTML metadata, embedded render payload, provenance sidecar, and browser-check sidecar; the embedded catalog equals the source JSON exactly; all 140 task identifiers and raster assets are present, with image bytes and hashes matching their source files. Public fields, generated and normalized chains, invalid verification output, unavailable stages, translation state and provenance, O/B/C structure, and full per-task raw records remain accessible. Status and scope language accurately identify a running partial snapshot with zero browser operations or business actions, not real submissions or a final result. Source text is held in a non-executable escaped JSON block and inserted with textContent, the CSP blocks network activity, no external dependency or unsafe DOM sink was found, and no template placeholder leaked.
